The '''''Stark Wing''''' was a Thaereian customs [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] that was used by the [[Thaereian military]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It had a crew of sixty, and was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jans Tolen]]. In c. [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was sent into the [[Cularin asteroid belt]] and encountered a number of [[Oblee|shadow lurkers]]&mdash;the incorporeal spirits of members of the Oblee [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;who attempted to contact the Thaereians by possessing a number of the ''Stark Wing''s crew. However, this caused the Thaereians to believe that they were being invaded, so they began attacking each other, resulting in the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of everyone aboard the ship. The derelict craft was later discovered by the [[Heroes of Cularin]].
